findings.title: Creation, test, and deed
findings.claim: The ayah forms a design-test-deed relation: completed making establishes the field, purpose-governed testing exposes the group, and deed-quality supplies the criterion.
findings.mechanism: The making carrier is completed, the purpose lām binds the testing verb to it, and the embedded selector with the deed specification turns the arranged field into a test whose result is action-quality.
findings.reader_payoff: The adornment clause becomes functional design leading toward a criterion, rather than a standalone report that the world is attractive.
findings.containment: The recurring formula is retained only at the level supplied by this packet; no external parallel is imported or used to displace the local syntax.

epistemic.reason: The local chain is grammatically grounded, while the formulaic extension is supplied through summarized inter-ayah evidence.

findings.title: The tested group
findings.claim: The human group is the direct object of testing, while the earth remains the bearer of adornment.
findings.mechanism: The bound masculine plural suffix on the testing verb marks the group as its object, whereas the preceding feminine suffix routes adornment back to the earth-side referent.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene separates the field that is adorned from the people whose conduct is exposed within it.
findings.containment: The claim concerns local object and antecedent relations; it does not infer a judgment on any individual member of the group.

epistemic.reason: The object suffix and attachment analysis are directly supplied and mutually aligned.

findings.mechanism: The testing verb is governed by purpose lām and is followed by a selector, an elative value term, and a deed specification, so pressure resolves into evaluation of conduct.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader perceives the test as disclosure of how action stands under pressure, not merely as the presence of difficulty.
findings.containment: Wearing, renewal, and other root images remain peripheral color in the supplied analysis; they do not replace the local testing sense.

findings.reader_payoff: The world's attractiveness is read as functionally connected to the question of conduct.
findings.containment: Purpose relation is asserted; no claim is made that every effect of adornment is exhausted by testing.

epistemic.reason: The particle's attachment and verbal mood are directly supplied by the local analysis.
